title: Uncle proud at the Basie dance in Owensboro
summary: Years later the Basie band played near Owensboro and his uncle and aunt came by buggy; the uncle told the crowd he had taught him.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Where I came from: parents, siblings and birth

blocks.x: Yeah, he loved it, you know. Oh, one of my most glorious moments, Stanley, was when I joined Count Basie in 19 -- I joined him, we played a dance in Owensboro, Kentucky, which is about 30 miles from where I was raised and my uncle and my aunt came to the dance.
Oh, that was absolutely -- he just performed. He just performed. He came up on the bandstand and he told everybody, "I taught him what he's doing today. I taught him, you know.
He must have been a proud man.
And he was pleased for you.
Yes, and he cried. And they came over to see me in a horse and buggy, 30 miles.
